description: This file defines utility functions for manipulating and verifying Git repository states, including setting, saving, and verifying file contents and commit HEADs. It appears to be used for testing or automating Git state management within a test environment.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Prepares specific content for a file in the working tree and index, then stages the file.

methods.name: save_state
methods.description: Saves the current worktree and index contents of a given file into separate backup files.

methods.name: set_and_save_state
methods.description: Sets the state of a file and then saves its current state.

methods.name: verify_state
methods.description: Verifies that a file's worktree and index contents match expected values.

methods.name: verify_saved_state
methods.description: Verifies that the saved state of a file matches its current worktree and index contents.

methods.name: save_head
methods.description: Saves the current commit's HEAD revision hash.

methods.name: verify_saved_head
methods.description: Verifies that the current HEAD revision hash matches the previously saved one.
